title: AI Prospecting Starter
audience: Freelance web developers who want a repeatable outbound process without APIs or automation builders.
shortDescription: Build a disciplined, evidence-based workflow with ChatGPT, Google Workspace, and a campaign tracker.
coreOutcome: Stop prospecting randomly. Build the process first.
problem: Manual prospecting is inconsistent, poorly tracked, and easy to abandon when client work gets busy.
situation: Every prospecting session begins with the same research, qualification, contact, writing, and follow-up decisions.
commonFailure: Automating before qualification rules and evidence standards are clear only makes weak prospecting run faster.
methodology: Define the campaign, verify current website evidence, qualify deliberately, personalize from evidence, and track every state.
whoItsFor: Freelance web developers who want human-controlled prospecting
whoItsNotFor: Teams seeking unattended API processing or n8n workflows
technicalBoundary: No unattended processing, API automation, n8n workflows, databases, or custom application infrastructure.
